incident: Overlapping vision technical-review assignments during transition from non-reusable synchronous reviewers
scope: Routing and historical work only. Duplicate reviews are not additional questions, additional required passes or permission to select a favorable verdict.

primaryVisionTechnical.assignmentClockMeaning: Timestamp supplied by the persistent session's initial kickoff, not an independently measured first-reading start time.

retiredFallbackVisionTechnical.originalAssignment: Review the one repaired vision-002 ai103-021 hash after the prior synchronous reviewer rejected follow-up messages.
retiredFallbackVisionTechnical.laterOverlappingAssignment: The owner observed the current index change to vision-003 and queued its five new hashes before learning that the author had created a persistent project reviewer explicitly assigned those hashes.
retiredFallbackVisionTechnical.status: Stopped after the current work; no further review authority.

resolution.selectionBasis: The persistent project reviewer was explicitly assigned vision-003 in its initial kickoff. The owner's fallback was originally assigned the obsolete vision-002 hash and was later routed to vision-003 without knowledge of the existing project assignment. Future vision technical review stays with the persistent project's original truthful identity.
resolution.findingsTreatment: Both actual outputs are preserved. Both reported five technical approvals for the same current hashes; neither is counted twice. Any substantive conflicting finding would require reconciliation rather than selecting the favorable result.
resolution.finalPipelineBinding: Use only the primary vision technical record in each current three-pass record. The fallback outputs remain separate historical audit evidence. Every current hash still requires a genuinely separate, later adversarial review and rubric.
resolution.prevention: Register and communicate the active reviewer handle and exact immutable batch before routing a continuation. A synchronous one-shot role cannot be continued by assuming its identity or reviewing in the author context.

agentsDomainContinuation.reason: The original synchronous reviewer cannot receive follow-up. New hashes receive a truthfully new reusable technical context and a distinct third context; prior holds remain unchanged. The three current technical holds are not overridden by launching an adversarial review.
